photometric_floor.method: In each 0.1 um source-wavelength bin, calculate 1.4826 times the MAD of log(measured/catalog-interpolated flux ratios) across comparison stars. Convert the resulting fractional scatter to Jy using the control-star smooth-model flux at that wavelength, then add it in quadrature to the formal uncertainty.
photometric_floor.reason: No 2MASS/AllWISE matched comparison-star flux ratios were measured; the Gaia-only pre-screen is below the required sample size. IRSA TAP error: DALServiceError: 502 Server Error: Proxy Error for url: https://irsa.ipac.caltech.edu/TAP/sync

astrometric_calibration.method: Per frame, subtract the median east/north Gaia residual across selected comparison stars; set the displacement threshold to three times 1.4826 times the MAD of radial residuals after removing the common frame offset. Require at least 20 comparison stars in a frame.
astrometric_calibration.reason: No comparison-star centroids were measured; the common frame offset and residual scatter are unknown.
